description: Open a file with Illustrator's open options: update legacy text and gradient meshes, convert a pre-CS4 document's crop area, print tiles or artwork bounds to artboards, keep it off the recent files list, or open it as a swatch, brush, symbol or graphic style library. Use open_document for a plain open

addToRecentFiles.description: List the file under File > Open Recent Files

convertCropAreaToArtboard.description: Pre-CS4 documents: turn the crop area into an artboard (otherwise it is discarded)

convertTilesToArtboards.description: Pre-CS4 documents: turn print tiles into artboards

createArtboardFromArtworkBounds.description: Pre-CS4 documents: make an artboard the size of the artwork

openAs.description: Open as a document (default) or as a library panel

preserveLegacyArtboard.description: Pre-CS4 documents: keep the legacy artboard

updateLegacyGradientMesh.description: Keep spot colours in gradient meshes from documents saved before CS3

updateLegacyText.description: Update type from documents saved before Illustrator CS

name: open_document_with_options
title: Open Document With Options
